places.name: Mount Kinabalu
places.ai_summary: The highest peak in Southeast Asia, offering breathtaking views and challenging trekking routes.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are mandatory for summit climbs.

places.place_tip: Book permits and guides well in advance.

places.name: Tunku Abdul Rahman Marine Park
places.ai_summary: A cluster of islands offering pristine beaches, snorkeling, and diving opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Ferry services available from Jesselton Point.

places.place_tip: Bring snorkeling gear and sunscreen.

places.name: Manukan Island
places.ai_summary: The most developed island in the park, known for its beautiful beaches and snorkeling spots.

opening_hours.notes: Ferry services available from Jesselton Point.

places.place_tip: Try the seafood at the island's restaurant.

places.ai_summary: A small island famous for its clear waters and vibrant coral reefs, ideal for snorkeling.

opening_hours.notes: Ferry services available from Jesselton Point.

places.place_tip: Bring your own snorkeling gear for the best experience.

places.ai_summary: A vibrant street market held every Sunday, offering local produce, handicrafts, and street food.

opening_hours.notes: Best to arrive early for the freshest produce.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the local delicacies and handicrafts.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 17:30.

places.place_tip: Visit during sunset for a breathtaking view.

places.ai_summary: A popular promenade in the city, perfect for a leisurely stroll, dining, and enjoying the sea breeze.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the night market.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food at the night market.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum's gift shop for souvenirs.

places.ai_summary: A hill located just outside the city, known for its cool climate, pine forests, and panoramic views.

places.place_tip: Bring a jacket as it can get chilly.

places.name: Kundasang War Memorial
places.ai_summary: A memorial park dedicated to the soldiers who fought in the Battle of Kundasang during World War II.

opening_hours.notes: Located about 2 hours' drive from Kota Kinabalu.

places.place_tip: Visit the memorial and the nearby Kundasang War Memorial Park.

places.name: Poring Hot Springs
places.ai_summary: Natural hot springs located in the Ranau district, known for their therapeutic properties.

opening_hours.notes: Located about 2 hours' drive from Kota Kinabalu.

places.place_tip: Bring a change of clothes and enjoy a dip in the hot springs.

places.name: Lok Kawi Wildlife Park
places.ai_summary: A wildlife park located south of Kota Kinabalu, home to various species of Bornean wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Located about 30 minutes' drive from Kota Kinabalu.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn more about the wildlife.

places.name: Tun Mustapha Tower
places.ai_summary: An iconic tower in Kota Kinabalu, offering a revolving restaurant and observation deck.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 21:30.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal at the revolving restaurant for a unique experience.

places.place_tip: Look for unique handicrafts and souvenirs to take home.
